assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
The denied service is CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring)
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of symptomatic atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
The diagnosis codes are I48.91, I49.5, and I49.9
There is a history of unexplained cardiac arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous electrocardiographic data during daily activities
